description: #14 §4's required non-conformance case, and the only fixture that discriminates: no member of a cycle is colored before the group resolves, so `b` is throwing though its own body only recurses. A memoized optimistic DFS passes all 47 others, answers `b` clean here, and loses the second diagnostic. Do not delete it as redundant.
